goal: Build a mobile robot with Nav2 navigation config: a Carter wheeled robot wrapped via setup_nav_robot. Realizes #31 RoboParty (mixed fleet) infrastructure for the mobile-robot leg.
thoughts:
Nav-robot specifics for CP-64 (2026-05-20 rewrite — fixes Carter-below-floor bug):
1) Carter spawned at z=0.30 (was 0.10 — caused Carter to spawn below ground and then jump upward at play).
   Rationale: /World/Ground Cube at z=-0.5 scale=[20,20,1] puts top face at z=0.0; Carter origin ~0.30m above wheel contact.
2) Three static obstacle boxes placed before occupancy map generation so planner sees them.
3) generate_occupancy_map called after obstacles exist; map_path fed to setup_nav_robot.
4) navigate_to issues an actual nav goal (3.0, 0.0) — robot drives during simulation.
5) setup_nav_robot wraps with Nav2 config: goal_topic=/goal_pose, odom_topic=/odom.
6) NO arm — pure mobile robot scenario.
7) Realizes #31 RoboParty mobile leg. Full scenario also has manipulator + ROS2 bridge + Nav2.
code:
create_prim(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", prim_type="DomeLight")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", attr_name="inputs:intensity", value=1000.0)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Ground", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, -0.5], scale=[20, 20, 1])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Ground", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

set_physics_scene_config(config={"enable_gpu_dynamics": False, "broadphase_type": "MBP"})

# Obstacle boxes — gives Nav2 planner something to route around
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Obstacle_A", prim_type="Cube", position=[2, 2, 0.25], scale=[0.5, 0.5, 0.5])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Obstacle_A", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Obstacle_B", prim_type="Cube", position=[-2, 1, 0.25], scale=[0.5, 0.5, 0.5])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Obstacle_B", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Obstacle_C", prim_type="Cube", position=[3, -1, 0.25], scale=[0.5, 0.5, 0.5])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Obstacle_C", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

# Carter (NVIDIA AMR) wheeled robot — z=0.30: ground top at z=0.0, Carter chassis origin ~0.30m above wheel contact
robot_wizard(
    robot_name="carter",
    dest_path="/World/Carter",
    position=[0, 0, 0.30],
    orientation=[1, 0, 0, 0],
)

# Build occupancy grid of current scene (obstacles must exist before calling this)
map_result = generate_occupancy_map(
    stage_resolution=0.05,
    ground_z=0.0,
    height_range=[0.1, 1.0],
)

setup_nav_robot(
    robot_path="/World/Carter",
    occupancy_map=map_result["map_path"],
    nav_topic="/goal_pose",
    odom_topic="/odom",
)

# Issue nav goal — drives to (3.0, 0.0) facing forward; planner routes around Obstacle_C
navigate_to(
    robot_path="/World/Carter",
    target_position=[3.0, 0.0],
    target_orientation=0.0,
)

verify_args.note: Mobile-robot nav setup diagnostic canonical — no cube delivery. Success criterion is presence of Carter prim + Nav2 config attrs (goal_topic, odom_topic). Measured via prim_exists on /World/Carter + list_attributes for nav config. Runtime nav stack execution requires Nav2 + ROS2 bridge active.

simulate_args.note: Drive Carter to (3.0, 0.0); verify robot moves from spawn position.
